newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uniwide sees 1997 net at 990 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Uniwide sees 1997 net at 990 mln pesos.

text.p: Retailer Uniwide Holdings Inc said on Thursday it expects to post a net income of 990 million pesos this year.
"This exceeds the original target of 930 million pesos due to the favourable business climate this year," said Jaime Cabangis, Uniwide chief financial officer in an analysts briefing.
Cabangis said the company's capital expenditures for 1997 would amount to 3.7 billion pesos. In 1998, this would be down to 3.4 billion pesos.
Uniwide earlier said its audited net income last year reached 763 million pesos from the previous year's 111.6 million.
